quiet: no S-NPP detection in the cell or an in-region ring-1 neighbour over the 7 days to the history day (Experiment 25's quiet_stratum, same definition as Experiments 13 and 18)
caught_within_7d: quiet fire whose cell was on the list on any of the 7 days up to and including the fire day

rankings.nearby_activity: Experiment 18: rings to nearest detection in 30 days, then active cells within 5 rings
rankings.burned_before: Experiment 18: earlier seasons (from 2018) the cell, then its ring-1 disk, had a detection

not_scored: Experiment 22 MLP/GRU: weather and lightning preprocessing inputs are missing from this checkout
bootstrap: 2000 resamples of whole ISO weeks, pooled over the six centres
